name: Hyperliquid
description: Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship decentralized exchange (DEX), the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, RWAs, and a full-fledged EVM.

methodology.Fees: 1% of perp and spot trading revenue (after builder code fees, maker rebates, HIP-3 deployer and unit revenue) share for HLP.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All fees share of HLP are distributed to vaults suppliers.

methodology.Fees: Include perps trading fees on crypto and HIP-3 deployed markets + builders fees, excluding all spot fees.
methodology.Revenue: 99% of fees go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding builders fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 99% of fees go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding builders fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 1% of fees go to HLP Vault suppliers, before 30 Aug 2025 it was 3% + fees for builders.
methodology.Volume: Track trading volume on all perps markets (including HIP-3 markets), excluding all spot markets volume.

Fees.Perp Fees: Perp trade fees collected as revenue, excluding spot fee.
Fees.Builder Code Fees: Fees added on top by other platforms building on top of Hyperliquid.
Fees.AQAv2 - USDC Yields: Hyperliquid gets 90% of cost-adjusted reserve yield revenue from stablecoin deployers

Revenue.Perp Fees: 99% of perp trade fees, excluding spot fees and builders fees.
Revenue.AQAv2 - USDC Yields: Hyperliquid gets 90% of cost-adjusted reserve yield revenue from stablecoin deployers

SupplySideRevenue.Builder Code Distribution: All extra fees added on top by builders are fully passed down to these platforms.
SupplySideRevenue.HLP: 1% of the perp trade fees go to HLP vault (used to be 3% before 30 Aug 2025)
SupplySideRevenue.HIP-3 Deployer Distribution: Fees are distributed back to HIP-3 markets deployers.
SupplySideRevenue.Maker Rebates: Fees are rebated and distributed back to makers.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 99% of perp trade fees (excluding spot fees and builders fees) for buy back HYPE tokens.
HoldersRevenue.HYPE Burn From Priority Fees: All prioroty fees will be used to buy and burn HYPE.
HoldersRevenue.AQAv2 - USDC Yields: Hyperliquid gets 90% of cost-adjusted reserve yield revenue from stablecoin deployers

methodology.Fees: Include spot trading fees (builder code fees included), unit protocol fees, and HYPE burned in successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions, excluding perps fees.
methodology.Revenue: 97% of spot trading fees before 30 Aug 2025 and 99% thereafter, after builder code fees and maker rebates, go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding unit protocol fees; HYPE paid in successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions is burned.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 97% of spot trading fees before 30 Aug 2025 and 99% thereafter, after builder code fees and maker rebates, go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding unit protocol fees; HYPE paid in successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions is permanently burned.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 1% of spot fees after builder code fees and maker rebates go to HLP Vault suppliers (3% before 30 Aug 2025), plus fees for unit protocol, spot builder code fees and spot maker rebates.

Fees.Spot Fees: Fees collected on all spot trades, excluding trades on markets with Unit assets (eg bridged BTC) and builder code fees.
Fees.Spot fees on Unit markets: Fees from spot trades on markets that include an asset deployed by Unit, excluding builder code fees, in these spot markets all fees go to Unit.
Fees.Builder Code Fees: Fees added on top of spot trades by other platforms building on top of Hyperliquid.
Fees.Spot Deployment Auction Burns: HYPE paid and permanently burned in successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions.

Revenue.Spot Fees: 97% of spot trade fees before 30 Aug 2025 and 99% thereafter, after builder code fees and maker rebates, excluding perp fees and unit protocol fees.
Revenue.Spot Deployment Auction Burns: HIP-1 token-deployment auction payments permanently burned rather than retained or distributed.

SupplySideRevenue.Unit Revenue: Fees earned on Unit spot markets go to Unit, after builder code fees paid in Unit assets.
SupplySideRevenue.HLP: 1% of the spot fees after builder code fees and maker rebates go to HLP vault (used to be 3% before 30 Aug 2025)
SupplySideRevenue.Builder Code Distribution: All builder code fees on spot trades are passed down to the platforms that routed them.
SupplySideRevenue.Maker Rebates: Spot fees rebated and distributed back to makers, all paid by Hyperliquid, including rebates paid in Unit assets.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 97% of spot trade fees before 30 Aug 2025 and 99% thereafter, after builder code fees and maker rebates, excluding perp fees and unit protocol fees, for buying back HYPE tokens.
HoldersRevenue.Spot Deployment Auction Burns: HYPE permanently removed from supply through successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions.

methodology.Volume: USD value of HIP-4 outcome-market trades on Hyperliquid: price times shares over every buy and sell fill, halved so each trade is counted once. Merges, splits and settlements are not trades and are excluded.
methodology.NotionalVolume: Shares traded on HIP-4 outcome markets, each share valued at its $1 payout, halved so each trade is counted once.
methodology.Fees: Fees users pay when closing or settling HIP-4 outcome positions, including builder-code fees added by front-ends. Hyperliquid charged no outcome fee of its own before 15 Aug 2026.
methodology.Revenue: 99% of outcome fees net of builder-code fees, sent to the Assistance Fund to buy HYPE.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Hyperliquid's protocol keeps no outcome fees; they go to the Assistance Fund and the HLP vault.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 99% of outcome fees net of builder-code fees, used by the Assistance Fund to buy back HYPE.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Builder-code fees paid to the front-ends that routed the trades, plus 1% of the remaining outcome fees to HLP vault depositors.

Fees.Outcome Fees: Fees on HIP-4 outcome positions closed or settled, excluding builder-code fees.
Fees.Builder Code Fees: Fees added on top by front-ends building on Hyperliquid, charged on outcome sells.

Revenue.Outcome Fees: 99% of outcome fees net of builder-code fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Builder Code Distribution: Builder-code fees passed in full to the front-ends that routed the trades.
SupplySideRevenue.HLP: 1% of outcome fees net of builder-code fees go to the HLP vault.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 99% of outcome fees net of builder-code fees, used to buy back HYPE.
